scripts.dev: concurrently -n realtime,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @kr-geo-guess/realtime" "npm run dev -w @kr-geo-guess/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kr-geo-guess/shared && npm run build -w @kr-geo-guess/realtime && npm run build -w @kr-geo-guess/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @kr-geo-guess/shared && npm run build -w @kr-geo-guess/realtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kr-geo-guess/shared && npm run typecheck -w @kr-geo-guess/realtime && npm run typecheck -w @kr-geo-guess/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @kr-geo-guess/shared && npm run build -w @kr-geo-guess/shared && npm run test -w @kr-geo-guess/realtime
